method: Scheduled Pillar Two 30-day news refresh (6 Nov 2026 HKT): WebSearch plus fetching primary official pages/PDFs for OECD, HK IRD, SG IRAS/MOF/SSO, and JP NTA. Items added only when date and content were confirmed against a fetched source.

coverage.OECD: Checked 6 Nov 2026: OECD IF plenary announcement (30 Oct) re-fetched; Tax Certainty Day 2026 (4 Nov) speech coverage (Bloomberg/Meijburg) is secondary remarks on a taxpayer-initiated GloBE coordination mechanism already foreshadowed in the plenary statement — no standalone OECD document published. No new model rules, AG, GIR or Central Record since catalogued items (plenary 30 Oct; GIR XML Schema v2.0 ~20 Oct; Romania STTR 2 Oct).
coverage.HK: Checked 6 Nov 2026: IRD What's New fetched. Only in-window Pillar Two item remains 26 Oct Portal BIR82 filing / e-assessments. 2–4 Nov What's New / press covers LegCo CARF & Amended CRS Bill — not Pillar Two. No new HKMTT/IIR guidance or portal change.
coverage.SG: Checked 6 Nov 2026: SSO Acts Supplement for Finance (Income Taxes) Act 2026 (No. 23 of 2026) fetched and read; new item added (sg-2026-11-04-finance-income-taxes-act-gazetted) — assent 29 Oct, published Acts Supplement 4 Nov 2026. SLW legislation list confirms Act 23 published 4 Nov. IRAS GloBE/DTT page and PwC Singapore Tax News (through 30 Oct) cross-checked; Third Edition e-Tax Guide (30 Oct), Bill passage (6 Oct) and QTI/SBTI list (13 Oct) already catalogued. MMT Regulations for safe harbours still pending.
coverage.JP: Checked 6 Nov 2026: NTA 新着情報 fetched (through 2 Nov). In-window catalogued items unchanged (GIR AEOI partners 21 Oct; 趣旨説明 9 Oct). 2 Nov tobacco hand-held stock tax; 30 Oct CbCR EOI partner-list update and 法人税基本通達 opinion solicitation confirmed non-Pillar Two (CbCR ≠ GIR). No new JP IIR/QDMTT/GIR administrative guidance.
